claims.anchor: `404.html` at root is honored as the custom 404 body
claims.claim: The Plazir Pages site serves its root 404.html bytes for missing routes; ds4cc.com does not expose a 404.html file and currently returns the stock GitHub Pages 404 body.
claims.observation: Plazir /404.html status=200; missing path status=404; both body SHA-256 f02b656cb925f54b069dbe82e78bd58daea8556428615b0020fa7a6955810f11. ds4cc /404.html status=404; missing path status=404; both body SHA-256 b620507312c5e97566a3c6cfaf99144fefc18a0da7d941401dfa0f5f58fb0368; body includes `<title>Page not found · GitHub Pages</title>` and `File not found`.

claims.claim: The current Plazir GHP missing-page document title is `Page not found`.
claims.observation: Missing-path GET status=404; its body hash equals /404.html; raw HTML title is `<title>Not found — Plazir-15</title>`.
claims.correction: As of 2026-10-21, the missing path returns HTTP 404 with bytes identical to /404.html, whose HTML title is `Not found — Plazir-15`; the body still contains the words `Page not found`.
